title: LightWeightSurvivalMods
description: Lightweight Fabric survival modpack with full performance optimization. Gain higher FPS, eliminate lag, and enjoy handy quality-of-life features while preserving authentic vanilla Minecraft gameplay.
body:
# Light Weight Survival Mods (LWSM)
LWSM is a lightweight modpack designed for players who prefer original Minecraft survival. It runs on the Fabric loader and focuses on optimization and basic quality-of-life improvements.

## Features
- Performance optimizations: Reduce lag, lower memory usage and stabilize game frame rate. Works well on low and mid-spec devices.
- Convenient tools: Add simple helper functions without changing vanilla game rules or balance.
- Shader support: Complementary Shaders is included for optional visual enhancement.
- Custom key shortcuts: Preset key bindings for faster in-game actions.

## Included content
- Performance & utility mods
- Official translation and spectator resource packs
- Pre-installed Complementary Shaders

You can adjust shaders, graphics options and key bindings according to your own needs after launching the game.
